title: Product and ProductVersion
description: A Product is a sellable platform offering (e.g. "baobab-xbt"); a ProductVersion is one immutable, versioned packaging of that offering as a CapabilityComposition. Product/ProductVersion carry no business logic and mint no runtime service -- ProductSubscription -> ProductVersion -> CapabilityComposition -> CapabilityGrant expansion is a baobab-platform/baobab-cp runtime responsibility (Technical Specification SS31).

owner.description: The Baobab repository/engine that owns this product's definition, e.g. "baobab-cp".

composition_key.description: The base CapabilityComposition this ProductVersion packages, e.g. "solution.baobab-xbt". Additional profiles/add-ons are selected per-subscription (see subscription.schema.json's subscription_profiles), not baked into the ProductVersion itself, so the same version can serve tenants with different profile combinations.
